expect_red: sweep: playback advances, loops, ping-pongs and stops at the end

mutations.contract: With loop off, playback stops ON the last point and clears `playing`, so the button flips back by itself. Out-and-back reverses instead, and reflects the overshoot rather than dropping it.
mutations.note: The mutation leaves `playing` true at the end. The index is right, the scene is right, and the only thing wrong is a play button that says it is still playing something that has stopped -- the kind of state lie a screenshot cannot catch and a reader notices immediately.
mutations.find:
next = next > last ? last : 0;
        out.playing = false;
